title: エリザベス女王杯の後に・横切った声

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: OH YEAAAAAH! I won the Queen Elizabeth II Cup! I'm the princess, the queen, the royal supreme!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Huh? This should be a day of joy, but so much of the audience looks unhappy. They're saying… a hooligan isn't fit to be queen?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The more I listen, the more I hear disapproving voices from every direction. Were people really hurt because of my wild behavior?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It even turns out that what Trainer was hiding from me before wasn't a present at all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I guess Trainer was trying to keep me from seeing all these negative letters… Am I a princess that nobody wants?
